intro: The Utopia bed gives you more than comfort. With sheesham wood’s natural durability, beautiful grain & easy-access storage, it’s made to make your space both elegant & practical.

features.title: Solid wood for lifelong strength
features.text: Crafted from sheesham wood, our bed naturally resists decay, giving you lasting durability without warping, splitting or needing frequent replacements.

features.title: Effortless storage under your bed
features.text: With smooth hydraulic lifting, underbed storage offers ample space for bedding, seasonal items or essentials — all easily accessible whenever you need them.

features.title: Beautiful grain, unique to your bed
features.text: The rich natural grain of sheesham wood gives every Utopia bed a distinct, one-of-a-kind look, adding organic beauty to your bedroom.

features.title: Cushioned backrest for extra comfort
features.text: The softly upholstered backrest offers gentle support for reading, relaxing, or working in bed, blending comfort with elegance.

features.title: Naturally resists termites & decay
features.text: Thanks to the natural properties of sheesham wood, your bed stays protected from termites, warping, and everyday wear — ensuring lasting beauty.

name: Utopia Queen Size Solid Wood Bed With Full Hydraulic Storage
